deploy-bot: deploybot started deployment inference-api tag=v2025.04.19-canary1 -> prod-cluster (canary 1/3)

alex (oncall): taking point for canary. change window until 2025-04-19T17:00Z. I'll watch p95 latency and 5xx rate.

mira (release-coordinator): Thanks. Backout criteria (from runbook): p95 latency > 250ms for 10m OR 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained 2m, or customer-facing errors spike. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-deploy-v2 :rotating_light:

sam (eng-sre): Adding immediate rollback commands here:
```
# fast rollback (image pin)
deployctl pin service/inference-api --image inference-api:v2025.04.18-rc3 --reason "emergency backout"
# kubernetes undo
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api --to-revision=5
```
